items.headline: Utah State LB Taggart exits loss in ambulance after tackle
items.description: Utah State linebacker Harrison Taggart was taken off the field in an ambulance after an injury while making a tackle in the second quarter of Saturday's 33-0 loss to No. 17 Utah, and program officials said he was in concussion protocol with a neck injury.
